usage: --source            Build from source (installs matching Go/Node versions)
--mirror <URL>      GitHub download accelerator prefix, e.g. https://ghproxy.net
--no-start          Install and write the service file, but do not start
--cpu-info          Print detected CPU architecture and dependency versions only
--uninstall         Stop the service and remove the program (keep data and .env)
--purge             With --uninstall, also remove the data directory and .env
1. The first start enters the setup wizard. When the script finishes, it prints the setup URL and token.
2. Runtime dependencies are installed automatically (skip with --no-deps):
kmod(modprobe), procps(pgrep/pkill), lsof, openssl, curl/tar/gzip/xz, tzdata
Missing nft/tc only limits rate limiting and firewall features; the panel still starts.
3. Source mode selects dependency versions based on the system:
- Go: reads the toolchain/go directive in go.mod; downloads a matching toolchain if the installed version is too old;
- Node: prefers official Node 22; uses the unofficial glibc-217 build when glibc < 2.28;
4. The .env written on first install contains only SAFE_PATHS, ensuring the setup wizard starts;
database and other settings are written by the wizard. An existing .env is never overwritten.
5. Agent install scripts are generated by the panel and install the same runtime dependencies automatically.
